data.gender_notes: Vagish is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vagish is recorded with the meaning “Voice of God”. Vagish is a Sanskrit name meaning “Voice of God”. in_marathi.name: Vagish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Voice of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vagish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Vagish, it signifies the one who has a voice similar to God's.

in_bengali.name: Vagish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Voice of God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vagish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Vagish, it signifies the one who has a voice similar to God's.
